plans.name: Free
plans.summary: Create, edit, publish and explore with the existing free allowances.

plans.name: Creator
plans.summary: Proposed: more storage, listing capacity and AI assistance.

plans.name: Studio
plans.summary: Proposed: larger libraries and expanded creation and automation allowances.

plans.name: 10 GB storage
plans.summary: Proposed storage add-on. The highest storage allowance applies; packages do not stack.

plans.summary: Proposed storage add-on. Existing files remain when an allowance expires; new uploads use the current limit.

features.name: Media storage
features.cost_driver: Stored bytes, operations and delivery bandwidth

features.free: Four requests per ten minutes, shared provider daily cap

features.activation: Explicit text consent; inference must be ready

features.name: AI music composition

features.upgrade: Longer arrangements and larger generation allowance
features.activation: Provider capacity, expanded score validation and measured cost

features.name: Automatic captions
features.cost_driver: Speech inference, source-audio processing and storage

features.name: AI voice narration
features.upgrade: More narration characters and voice choices
features.activation: Working speech provider and per-character budget

features.name: Voice cloning
features.cost_driver: Voice-model training, consent verification and inference

features.name: Video exports
features.cost_driver: Worker CPU/GPU time, output storage and delivery

features.activation: Worker recovery, acceptance tests and capacity; not sold yet

features.name: Agentic automation
features.cost_driver: Inference, scheduled jobs, retries and provider operations
